editorial:
Imagine being in the middle of a high-stakes court case and suddenly realizing your water just broke. That is exactly the chaos you get with Amal and Tawfiq. Amal is a hardworking lawyer who refuses to slow down even in her final months of pregnancy, while her husband, a vet, is mostly just stressed out and worried. The movie feels like a hectic day in the life of a couple who love each other but can't seem to stop arguing about their different priorities. It is a lighthearted mix of family drama and laugh-out-loud comedy that captures the panic of becoming a parent.

You will really enjoy the chemistry between the lead actors, as they make the bickering feel real and relatable. The pacing is quick, and the courtroom scene is easily the highlight of the film. While some of the side plots feel a bit rushed, the heart of the story stays strong.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with Amal finally giving birth after all the courtroom madness. The experience forces her and Tawfiq to stop fighting and actually support one another. You see them move past their arguments as they embrace the new challenges of parenthood. The movie ends on a sweet note, showing that while their marriage was rocky, the arrival of their baby brought them closer together and gave them a fresh start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves relatable family comedies and stories about working parents.
